note: Entries the project must stop offering, which a collaborator cannot delete: `delete_files` works only for the project owner, so a removed or renamed component leaves its files behind and its card keeps loading a preview that names an export the bundle no longer has — it reads as broken rather than absent. What a collaborator CAN do is overwrite, so build-cards.mjs writes each of these as a page that states what happened. When the owner does delete them, drop the entry from here.

AppShell.headline: AppShell is now AppLayout
AppShell.detail: The component was renamed. Use `AppLayout`, which has the same shell with its own card in Navigation.

Tooltip.headline: Tooltip is a directive, not a component
Tooltip.detail: The design system ships `dsTooltip` as an attribute directive, so there is no element to register and nothing to compose. A tooltip is revealed on hover, which a static card cannot show anyway.

ModalConfirm.headline: ModalConfirm is built by a service
ModalConfirm.detail: The component declares no inputs at all — it reads its content from an injected MODAL_CONFIRM_DATA token, so ModalService.confirm() is the only thing that can construct one. Its declaration and prompt are still published, because an agent reading the library needs to know it exists.

ToastRegion.headline: ToastRegion cannot be shown in a card
ToastRegion.detail: The region takes only `maxVisible`; its entries come from `ToastService.show()` and `.promise()` inside the app, so a static preview can render nothing but an empty box. Its declaration and prompt are still published.
